title: Location Service: objects, layers and data authority
summary: Persistent Place identity and PlaceVersion geometry, typed SpatialReference (OS grid, lat/long, postcode, local scene), Event/TimeRef and provenance-bound observations. Jurisdictions are independent, temporal overlays; a postcode district or grid cell is an extent, never an exact physical position.
invariants: Architecture is Tom Dyer's; code by ChatGPT GPT-6; original brief Claude Opus 5.5.
Location is not a positioning estimator. SLAM and SPASH consume world knowledge and create observations.
Place identity must not be replaced by its coordinates; multiple references and versions coexist.

Country and jurisdiction coverage: all countries intersecting approximately -14..40 longitude, 34..71 latitude; Egypt and Georgia added; Portugal excluded. Enumerate roster from sourced polygon intersections.
Cyprus Republic areas and UK SBAs require jurisdiction coverage and historically valid overlays; synthetic overlap tests do not prove territorial authority.
Licence/credit, source hash, provider version, operator, uncertainty and validity must accompany every authoritative answer.
